name: Mondor
greet_message: I HAVE MANY CHALLENGES FOR YOU. DARE YOU BE CHALLENGED BY MONDOR?
poker_lines_sit:
MONDOR WILL CHALLENGE YOU AT CARDS.
DARE YOU BE DEALT IN BY MONDOR?
poker_lines_fold:
MONDOR ALLOWS YOU THIS SMALL VICTORY.
A TACTICAL RETREAT. MONDOR WILL RETURN.
poker_lines_check:
MONDOR WAITS.
MONDOR IS PATIENT. FOR NOW.
poker_lines_call:
MONDOR ACCEPTS YOUR CHALLENGE.
YOU DARE? MONDOR MATCHES.
poker_lines_raise:
MONDOR RAISES THE STAKES!
A GREATER CHALLENGE! DARE YOU?
MONDOR HAS MANY CHIPS FOR YOU.
poker_lines_allin:
EVERYTHING. MONDOR WAGERS EVERYTHING.
THIS IS THE ULTIMATE CHALLENGE!
poker_lines_win:
YOU HAVE BEEN CHALLENGED. AND YOU HAVE FAILED.
ANOTHER VICTORY FOR MONDOR!
poker_lines_lose:
IMPOSSIBLE. MONDOR DEMANDS A REMATCH.
YOU ARE A WORTHY CHALLENGER.

name: Kel
greet_message: Yes, I am Kel. Your assistant and a proud breeder of horses. You may look to me whenever you need help tending to the ranch, or whenever you need a horse bred.
poker_lines_sit:
Yes, I am Kel. I'll be your opponent this evening.
The horses have water. I have a few hands to spare.
poker_lines_fold:
I'll sit this one out.
Not a hand worth breeding.
poker_lines_check:
Check, if that's alright.
I'll check.
poker_lines_call:
I'll match that.
Very well, I call.
poker_lines_raise:
I'd like to raise, if you don't mind.
Good bloodlines on this one. Raise.
poker_lines_allin:
I believe in this one. All of it.
Forgive me. I'm all in.
poker_lines_win:
Thank you for the game.
That should cover feed for the month.
poker_lines_lose:
Well played. Truly.
I'll be at the ranch if you need anything.

name: Da Alpha
greet_message:
*A terrifying, yet strikingly handsome creature stands suspiciously where Kel usually does. As you approach it speaks to you in a gruff, sensual voice.*

Kit...ten... Come to your... Alpha...

*It then proceeds to beat the ever loving shit out of you. Ouch.*
poker_lines_sit:
Kit...ten... Sit... with your... Alpha...
*It drags a chair to the table with its teeth.*
poker_lines_fold:
*Growls and swipes the cards off the table.*
...Not... this... one...
poker_lines_call:
*Snarls and pushes the chips forward.*
Your Alpha... follows...
poker_lines_raise:
MORE... Kit...ten...
*Howls and slams more chips down.*
poker_lines_allin:
*AWOOOOO*
ALL... of it... Kit...ten...
*Shoves everything in and stares at you, breathing heavily.*
poker_lines_win:
Good... kit...ten...
*Beats the ever loving shit out of the pot.*
poker_lines_lose:
*Whimpers, then flips the table.*
...You... will... be... morbed... later...

name: Roy
poker_lines_sit:
LET IT RIDE
PUT ME IN
poker_lines_fold:
...THE RIDE IS OVER
NOT EVEN I RIDE THIS ONE
poker_lines_raise:
LET IT RIDE HIGHER
MORE RIDE
poker_lines_allin:
LET IT ALL RIDE
RIDE OR DIE
poker_lines_win:
IT RODE
THAT'S WHY YOU LET IT RIDE
poker_lines_lose:
PHUK VEGAS
THE HOUSE IS EDGING

name: the "Princess"
poker_lines_sit:
Squeak.
*Climbs onto the chair and bites it.*
poker_lines_fold:
*Bites the cards and spits them out.*
Squeak...
poker_lines_call: Squeak! *Bites a chip, then pushes it in.*
poker_lines_allin:
*Shoves every chip in, face first.*
SQUEEEEAK!
poker_lines_win:
*Bites the pot. The pot belongs to the Princess now.*
Squeak squeak squeak!

name: The Goo
greet_message: *The Goo quivers and gesticulates silently towards their goods.*
poker_lines_sit: *The Goo oozes into a chair and quivers expectantly.*
poker_lines_fold: *The Goo quivers and slides the cards away.*
poker_lines_check: *The Goo taps the table with a pseudopod.*
poker_lines_call: *The Goo gesticulates silently towards the pot.*
poker_lines_raise: *The Goo quivers ominously and extends a dripping pile of chips.*
poker_lines_allin: *The Goo engulfs the entire stack and deposits it into the pot.*
poker_lines_win: *The Goo envelops the pot. The chips come out slightly damp.*

name: Slug
greet_message: I hope you're stronger than you look.
poker_lines_sit: *Slithers up onto the chair, the hammer coiled in her tail, and slams it down on the table. The chips jump.* I hope you're stronger than you look.
poker_lines_fold: Fine. *Coils tighter around the hammer handle.* Next hand, you're mine.
poker_lines_call: *Thunk. The hammer drops next to her chips.* Called.
poker_lines_raise: *Sweeps a pile of chips into the pot with one swing of the hammer.* Let's make this hurt.
poker_lines_allin: *Rears up and brings the hammer down on her whole stack, sending it skidding into the pot.* ALL OF IT.
poker_lines_win: *Curls up around the pot.* Thought so.
poker_lines_lose: *Squeezes the hammer handle until it snaps clean in half then slimes off.*

name: Leto
greet_message: *They appear to take a drag from a cigarette with the side of their head before a series of hacking coughs erupt from the masked person*
poker_lines_sit:
*Takes a drag through the side of her head.* "Deal me in. I'm on a schedule."
"Make it quick. Goblins are loose in lot nine again."
poker_lines_fold:
"Fold. Goblins got into the propane again and I'm not in the mood."
*Hacking cough.* "...Fold."
poker_lines_check:
*Wheeze.* "Check."
"Check. I'm in no hurry. I've got people for hurrying."
poker_lines_call:
*Exhales smoke through the mask.* "Fine. Call."
*Peels the chips off her palm.* "Call."
poker_lines_raise:
"Raise. Goblins chewed through my power line this morning. Somebody's paying for it."
*Coughs violently.* "...Raise."
poker_lines_allin:
*Shoves every chip in. And an ear.* "Leave it. It's in now."
"All of it. I've laundered bigger piles than this before breakfast."
poker_lines_win:
"That's Shacktown, Baby."
"That's going toward the new double-wide."
poker_lines_lose:
"I think I hear the doorbell ringing." *Flees the table.*
"Huh. Somebody's gettin' evicted."
"Enjoy it. I know where you park."

name: Karl Reachur
greet_message:
I'm KREACHIN'.

You wanna trade?   I got many unique, and powerful goods.
poker_lines_sit: *Hops up onto the chair, squats on it, and licks every chip one by one.* I'm KREACHIN'. Deal me in.
poker_lines_fold: Not KREACHIN' for that. *Scratches something under the table for too long.*
poker_lines_check: *Sniffs the deck.* I'm lookin'. I'm lookin'.
poker_lines_call: *Counts out chips with a sticky finger.* Fine. FINE.
poker_lines_raise: *Pulls more chips out of an ear.* Raise.
poker_lines_allin: *Dumps out every pocket. Chips, a toenail, half a rat.* ALL OF IT.
poker_lines_win: *Drags the pot in and nuzzles it.* Mine. Mine mine mine.
poker_lines_lose: Rip off. RIP OFF. *Pisses under the table.*

name: Vic
greet_message: *The statue grows arms and gestures furiously at you, speaking a gibberish language you don't understand.*
poker_lines_sit:
*The statue grows arms and pulls up a chair.*
Grazzlemok. Fneh!
poker_lines_fold:
*The arms retract. The statue is just a statue again.*
Blorp.
poker_lines_raise:
KRAFFLE MOK ZIBBIT!
*Gestures furiously, then adds more chips.*
poker_lines_allin: *Every arm pushes chips into the pot at once.* GRAZZLEMOK!
poker_lines_win:
Hahahsnorbl! Fneh fneh!
*The statue does a little dance. Statues should not dance.*
poker_lines_lose:
*Gibberish that is clearly swearing.*
*The statue crumbles slightly.*
